comments.author: @UnrealWorldJourney1
comments.text: What makes Iceland so fascinating is how deeply geography shapes everyday life. 🇮🇸 Volcanoes, glaciers, geothermal energy, long winters and isolation have influenced everything from housing and heating to traditions and social habits. It’s a great example of how a harsh environment can help create a society that feels both ancient in its roots and remarkably modern at the same time.
